item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 01/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The broad trough of low pressure over the northern part of the South China Sea will bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of southern China today. Tropical Cyclone Khanun will move across the vicinity of the Ryukyu Islands today and tomorrow, and then towards the East China Sea. Its outer subsiding air will bring very hot weather to southeastern China in the middle and latter parts of this week, but showers and thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures will affect the region. A southwesterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China during the weekend and early next week.
